title: Put authorization outside the agent
supabiz_proposal: Mediate protected effects through a server-owned gateway and credential broker, outside model control.

title: Review the exact action in task context
supabiz_proposal: Combine trusted task, applicable policy and relevant verified prior receipts with a canonical proposed action.

title: Keep deterministic authority above model judgment
supabiz_proposal: A model can restrict or escalate an otherwise permitted action; it cannot override tenant scope, hard limits or mandatory human review.

title: Bind approval to one immutable proposal
supabiz_proposal: Bind business, recipient, arguments, file versions, amount/currency, policy and expiry. Material edits create a new approval request.

title: Separate hold, deny and missing context
supabiz_proposal: Show ready, denied, needs-context, awaiting-approval and review-unavailable with concrete next steps.

title: Make execution status explicit
supabiz_proposal: Show not yet executed separately from approved, dispatched, verified and outcome unknown.

title: Give each agent an owner and bounded lifetime
supabiz_proposal: Registry includes business, responsibility, owner, capabilities, expiry, pending work, pause and retirement.

title: Recheck authority at commit
supabiz_proposal: Revalidate current policy, membership, approver authority, task status and resource versions before dispatch.

title: Cover browser and desktop execution paths
supabiz_proposal: A gateway cannot protect effects performed through unmediated browser sessions, shells or device automation. Restrict alternate capabilities.

title: Make approval a readable work card
supabiz_proposal: Show effect, business/matter, recipient, cost/files, evidence, reason, expiry and next step. Keep payload details in a secondary view.

title: Turn natural-language rules into reviewed policy
supabiz_proposal: Version constraints and examples; resolve ambiguity before an authorized owner publishes changes.

title: Persist approvals without holding workers
supabiz_proposal: Durable state and resumption let people review asynchronously without an active LLM session.

title: Treat retries and uncertain outcomes explicitly
supabiz_proposal: Use execution claims, outbox, provider idempotency and reconciliation. A timeout is not proof that nothing happened.

title: Enforce cumulative budgets and independent business scope
supabiz_proposal: Reserve aggregate purpose/time-window budgets and require separate authority for Consu and ForeFathers.

title: Learn from adjudicated outcomes, not clicks alone
supabiz_proposal: Store policy/evidence versions, reviewer decisions, human judgment and actual outcomes separately; promote scoped corrections with regression tests.

title: Evaluate contextual reviewers before specializing
supabiz_proposal: Compare deterministic rules alone, rules plus general reviewer, and rules plus specialized reviewer under equal hard rights and frozen cases.
measure: False allows/blocks; abstention; cost and p95

title: Maintain permission-aware review evidence
supabiz_proposal: Reviewers and approvers see only authorized source context; task text and retrieved instructions cannot manufacture permission.

title: Make delegation and emergency pause explicit
supabiz_proposal: Scope and expire delegated authority; pause acknowledges future/in-flight status. Receiving businesses retain independent authority.
measure: Unauthorized delegation; effects after acknowledged pause
